top_choice_rationale: P001 honours the original theoretical work (Kane and Mele, who wrote both 2005 papers together and cannot honestly be separated) and the original experiment (Molenkamp's 2007 HgTe quantized edge conductance), verified independently for almost twenty years and distinct from the 2016 topological prize. P003 ranks second because it credits the real 3D ARPES experiment of Hasan, but it splits Kane from Mele and so leaves the theoretical credit less certain. P002 is a genuine invention, but it follows the 2005 and 2012 metrology prizes and its fundamental-physics output is still limits. Any award is preferred to no award given the mature, verified candidates.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P003; institutional contacts only with Katori (University of Tokyo Fellow since 2025), no collaboration; Chalmers colleague Johansson noted for transparency
